property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee that may revert, the reference contract always reverts the entire transfer call when the external per-recipient call fails; the mutant instead ignores failing external calls and returns true, so there exists inputs (a non-empty _tos and a reverting callee) where the reference reverts but the mutant returns true.
change_summary: Remove the revert on failed call so transfer returns true even if callee call fails, flipping revert behavior for failing external calls.
